title: 消除设置页下拉 Coordinator 隔离告警与生命周期测试死变量

target.design_doc: docs/devel/design/04-设置中心与价格校准交互.md

why: 设置中心「添加服务」下拉的 Coordinator 是 NSObject 子类却未声明 @MainActor，@objc didSelect 直接读取 NSPopUpButton.indexOfSelectedItem（主线程控件），Swift 6 报跨隔离引用告警。NativeLifecycleHarness 的 cancel 用例捕获 graceAction 后从不读取，报「written to, but never read」告警，同时让「存在运行任务时确实安排了宽限期回调」这一事实失去断言。两处都在构建中稳定复现，均为编译期卫生与测试有效性修复。

precheck.description: 强制重编两个文件并构建，确认两条告警仍真实存在
precheck.command: touch apps/macos/Sources/BruceApp/Settings/ProviderPopUpPicker.swift apps/macos/Tests/Harnesses/NativeLifecycleHarness/NativeLifecycleHarness.swift && zsh -c 'source scripts/swift-sdk.zsh && Bruce_prepare_swift_sdk && swift build --package-path apps/macos 2>&1' | grep -E 'ProviderPopUpPicker.swift.*(isolation|nonisolated)|NativeLifecycleHarness.swift.*graceAction'
precheck.expected: 命中 ProviderPopUpPicker 的 indexOfSelectedItem 跨隔离告警与 NativeLifecycleHarness 的 graceAction 死变量告警
precheck.evidence: 2026-10-28 预检构建（日志 local/c144-precheck-build.log）：ProviderPopUpPicker.swift:67:32 main actor-isolated property indexOfSelectedItem 跨隔离引用；NativeLifecycleHarness.swift:328:13 variable graceAction written but never read（C145 改动后行号）

after: zsh -c 'source scripts/swift-sdk.zsh && Bruce_prepare_swift_sdk && swift build --package-path apps/macos'

changes.before: Coordinator 继承 NSObject 未声明隔离，@objc didSelect 直接读取 sender.indexOfSelectedItem
changes.after: Coordinator 标注 @MainActor，与 NSViewRepresentable 的 MainActor 契约一致
changes.impact: 消除跨隔离引用告警；索引映射与占位项处理逻辑不变

changes.scope: 退出取消用例的断言有效性
changes.before: cancelTerminationRestoresScheduling 捕获 graceAction 后不再读取，只验证 cancel 恢复调度
changes.after: 新增断言：存在运行任务时 beginTermination 必须安排宽限期回调（graceAction 非 nil），再验证 cancel 恢复调度
changes.impact: 消除死变量告警，并让该用例同时覆盖「宽限期已安排」这一前置事实

design.doc: docs/devel/design/04-设置中心与价格校准交互.md

verification.signoff: 2026-10-29 人类口头确认 (AI 代签)

checks.true_if: 重新构建后 ProviderPopUpPicker 与 NativeLifecycleHarness 两条告警均消失，构建退出码 0
checks.false_if: 任一条告警仍出现，或改动引入编译错误
checks.evidence: 2026-10-28 修复后重编并构建（日志 local/c143-c144-fix-build.log）：ProviderPopUpPicker 与 NativeLifecycleHarness 无告警命中，构建 exit 0

checks.true_if: 占位项索引 0 仍映射为 nil，其余索引仍映射 providers[index - 1]
checks.false_if: 索引偏移改变、占位项被当成有效 provider，或选择回调不再写回 Binding
checks.evidence: didSelect 逻辑未改：占位项 index 0 → nil，其余取 providers[index - 1] 写回 Binding；唯一改动是 Coordinator 的 @MainActor 标注

checks.true_if: NativeLifecycleHarness 全部用例通过，且新增断言在有运行任务时成立
checks.false_if: Harness 失败，或新增断言在正常路径上失败
checks.evidence: NativeLifecycleHarness 14 项通过；新增断言「有运行任务时退出应先安排宽限期回调」在 beginTermination 后成立

checks.true_if: scripts/verify-local.sh Exit 0，Rust workspace 与全部 Harness 全绿
